user.title: OCPP Charge Proxy
user.description: Run the proxy inside Home Assistant, or connect to an optional standalone deployment. Native operation needs no broker or app.

native.title: Provider connection
native.description: Core restarts interrupt native proxy connections. Use your provider-assigned OCPP credentials. An account linked through a consumer API may not expose these credentials.

relay.title: Transparent relay listener
relay.description: Point the charger at this host and port using /<chargepoint_id> and its original Basic credentials. Stop any other connection using this identity first. Both TLS paths are required together; without them WS is plaintext on a trusted LAN. Upstream TLS verification is always enabled.

emulator.title: Virtual charger identity
emulator.description: When moving from a standalone emulator, stop it before finishing and copy its serial number and latest import register to preserve identity and energy continuity. The register is a first-start or migration seed, not a live meter adjustment.

external.title: Standalone proxy
external.description: Use an API URL reachable from Core; localhost usually does not address an app container. Before leaving a native emulator, copy its serial {serial} and register {energy_wh} Wh to the standalone app, then stop the current runtime before starting the replacement.

hassio_confirm.title: Standalone proxy discovered
hassio_confirm.description: A standalone proxy was found at {url}. This explicitly configures an external connection; native operation does not require this app.

stop_native.title: Stop native proxy for handoff
stop_native.description: Stop and flush the native runtime before starting its standalone replacement. The next form shows its final serial/register. If you cancel after stopping, reload this integration to resume native operation. Complete the handoff before restarting Core.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the standalone proxy API.
error.invalid_config: Invalid configuration. Check the host, credentials, current and paired TLS paths.
error.handoff_serial_required: Copy the existing emulator serial number before switching backends.
error.confirm_required: Confirm stopping the native proxy before continuing.
error.cannot_stop: Could not unload the native integration. Stop the handoff and check its status.
error.handoff_unavailable: Cannot verify the saved emulator serial/register. Reload native operation or recover its saved state before switching.

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the discovered standalone proxy.

init.title: Emulator power input
init.description: This input applies only to emulator mode. Unavailable or invalid readings restore simulation. Use Reconfigure to change deployment, credentials, operating mode or listener settings.
